title: GitHub code review
description: Review requested pull-request heads, record exact-head decisions, stop early on out-of-scope changes, and optionally request a code-aware human maintainer after approval or a maintainer-decision scope stop.
goalTemplate: Review labelled pull requests for repositories {{repositories}}. Trigger label: {{triggerLabel}}. Requested reviewer: {{requestedReviewer}}. Tone: {{reviewTone}}. Maintainers: {{maintainers}}. Cadence {{checkFrequency}} ({{timezone}}). Use GitHub token secret {{githubTokenSecret}} (never print it).

params.label: Check frequency
params.description: How often to look for newly labelled pull requests.

params.label: Timezone
params.description: Timezone the schedule is interpreted in.

params.label: Repositories
params.description: Repositories whose pull requests will be reviewed. Each is polled independently.

params.label: Trigger label
params.description: Only pull requests carrying this label are reviewed.

params.label: Requested reviewer
params.description: GitHub login whose review request starts an event-driven review.

params.label: Review tone
params.description: How detailed the review comments should be.

params.label: GitHub token secret
params.description: Name of a saved secret. Include it so the agent can use GitHub.
